lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell seals the raw battle logs in three separate drives.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Hollowmere manifests, cleanup weapons locks, standardized attacker components.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Enough to prove the reports were prepared before the fighting.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: We take it through the official chain. Aldric answers in a room full of witnesses.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then he can condemn himself using them.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Once those doors open, they will control the cameras.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: And if the council already knows?

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then we learn exactly how large the lie is.
